critical_code_review_comments: server.py: normalize_phone strips whitespace/(-)/() and prepends + (stripping leading 0) then enforces E.164 regex ^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$ — correct, matches spec.
OTP is bcrypt-hashed at rest (hash_code/verify_code) and expires_at is indexed with TTL via db.otps.create_index expireAfterSeconds=0 — good.
OTP_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=30 enforced by finding latest otp doc per phone; delete_many then insert_one guarantees single active OTP per phone.
verify_otp: increments attempts on wrong code, deletes doc on success (single-use), returns 400 on missing/expired otp and 429 at MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS=5 — matches all backend test cases.
TokenOut returns UserOut with phone (no email field) — matches UserOut model; users collection has unique index on phone.

Legacy email-based fixtures in old backend_test.py were incompatible; DELETED /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and replaced with test_kpchat_phone_otp.py. Existing test_reactions_reply_audio.py still references email/password login helper — will need refactor when reactions/reply retest is needed; flagged for next iter.
server.py grew to 779 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into auth.py / chats.py / messages.py / files.py / ws.py modules.
Frontend: theme.ts brandPrimary #0084FF (light) and #0A84FF (dark) — light matches spec exactly.
verify.tsx uses initial cooldown=30 on mount and 30 on resend — matches backend OTP_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=30.
settings.tsx renders user?.phone directly (styles.email kept as class name but content is phone) — visual result correct.
